classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read by `_prefetch` in a separate multiprocessing.Process with a depth-8 queue while the main loop computes (probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s)), so each file's single read_staged call is overlapped rather than waited on.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: the main loop calls probe.read_staged on one mask file per iteration inline and times the stall (gated.append) before it can proceed to compute, and no barrier holds other ranks during it.
